LightningComponentBundle.description: Reusable booking component for PD, FSS, and IC scheduling. Reads ?type=PD/FSS/IC from URL.

property.name: bookingType
property.label: Booking Type
property.description: PD, FSS, or IC. Leave blank to read from URL ?type= parameter.

property.name: contactId
property.label: Contact ID
property.description: Pre-fill contact. Leave blank to read from URL ?contactId= parameter.

property.name: opportunityId
property.label: Opportunity ID
property.description: Link booking to Opportunity. Leave blank to read from URL.
